11.text: One of the fire-boards, usually the most ancient, is considered the pro-

12.text: tector of the herd; another protects the hunting-pursuits; a third guards the

15.text: and the herd is divided between the heirs, when each portion must have at

35.text: over the herd. One tale relates that two wooden

36.text: men without feet, who looked like fire-boards, came

37.text: to a reindeer-breeder whose animals were very restive.
